revised_prompt: Create a modern digital card optimized for Twitter with a size of 1200x675 pixels, maintaining a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use a dark background with color code #0d0d0d. To the left of center, position a circular glowing logo. The right side of the card should feature a flowing purple-to-teal gradient, which strikes a balance of adding visual interest without distracting from the main elements. Overlay the image with the text 'Good Flippin Design' and 'Strategic Web Development' in white with a subtle glow, ensuring the text remains readable even when the image size is reduced. The overall aesthetic should evoke a professional tech brand, and should look good within a Twitter timeline preview.
